**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We believe people will keep finding new ways to work, build and contribute—and we’re ready to shape that future.

2. We believe superintelligent AI, if built within the next 20 years, will create more jobs than it eliminates. The future of work isn’t a fixed pie: new tools open new possibilities, and people turn possibilities into livelihoods.

3. Superintelligent AI will create more jobs than it eliminates if it’s built within the next 20 years. We’re confident people will adapt, new industries will emerge, and work will evolve. Let’s make sure everyone can take part.

**(b) Newsletter opening — 107 words**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. That future is not something we need to fear; it is something we can prepare for and shape. As powerful new capabilities emerge, people will find new needs to meet, new services to offer and new industries to build. Work will change, and change can be demanding, but our conviction is clear: there will be more jobs on the other side. We’re focused on helping people and communities seize those opportunities, adapt as roles evolve and ensure the gains from technological progress reach widely. We can build a future of work with room for more people.
